LESSON: JOHN THE BAPTIST

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.1: John the Baptist

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: John the Baptist
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is the message of John the Baptist still relevant today?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the teachings of John the Baptist
2. practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: explain the teachings of John the Baptist

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain the teachings of John the Baptist.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “explain the teachings of John the Baptist” using a school example.
• Model B for “explain the teachings of John the Baptist” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain the teachings of John the Baptist" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist

Teach
• Today’s focus: practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist” using a school example.
• Model B for “practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: explain the teachings of John the Baptist
• Model 2: practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: explain the teachings of John the Baptist
2. Practise: practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for John the Baptist.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is the message of John the Baptist still relevant today?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain the teachings of John the Baptist
• practise the values learnt from the teachings of John the Baptist

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
